description:
Compare guest post prices for a list of websites across marketplaces and open catalogs.

    Accepts domains or full URLs (e.g. a competitor's backlink list). For each site found: price per marketplace,
    the best price and where, how much cheaper it is than the most expensive offer, DR and traffic. DR — Ahrefs
    (Domain Rating by Ahrefs) where dr_source is "ahrefs", otherwise as reported by sellers; traffic as reported by
    sellers. Sites not sold on any marketplace are listed in not_found.

domains.description: Websites or URLs to compare, e.g. ["techbullion.com", "https://example.com/page"]. Without sign-in up to 50 per call (more — the client is asked to sign in), signed in up to 1,000.
domains.title: Domains

niche.description: Price for a special niche where marketplaces set one: general (default), igaming, crypto, cbd or adult.
niche.title: Niche

name: compare_prices
title: Compare guest post prices
